name: Baked Chicken Tenders with Mustard Yogurt Dip
steps: Coat the chicken strips in egg then almond flour, parmesan and paprika and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 16 minutes.
Stir the yogurt and mustard for dipping.

name: Mini Turkey Burger Sliders on Lettuce
steps: Shape twelve mini patties and sear 4 minutes a side.
Serve in lettuce leaves with tomato, pickle and mustard.

name: Cheesy Chicken and Broccoli Quesadillas
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with chicken, chopped steamed broccoli and cheddar and fold.
Crisp in a pan 2 minutes a side and serve with salsa.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
steps: Roast the sweet potato cubes with cumin.
Warm the beans and tortillas and fill with potato, beans and avocado; finish with lime and cilantro.

name: Pesto Chicken Zucchini Boats
steps: Scoop the zucchini halves.
Fill with shredded chicken mixed with pesto and tomatoes, top with mozzarella and bake at 400°F for 22 minutes.

name: Garlic Shrimp Tacos with Avocado Crema
steps: Sear the garlicky shrimp in oil.
Blend the avocado, yogurt and lime into a crema.
Fill the tortillas with shrimp, cabbage and crema.

name: Greek Chicken and Rice Skillet with Spinach and Feta
steps: Brown the chicken and garlic.
Add the cooked rice, broth, oregano and lemon and heat 8 minutes.
Fold in the spinach and top with feta.

name: Beef and Broccoli Cauliflower Rice Bowls
steps: Sear the sliced steak and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger; add the cauliflower rice.
Return the steak with soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Italian Stuffed Mushroom Caps with Turkey Sausage
steps: Remove the mushroom stems and chop.
Brown the sausage with the stems and garlic, mix with the cream cheese and parmesan.
Fill the caps and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Greek Yogurt Chicken Salad Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Hollow the tomatoes.
Mix the chicken with yogurt, celery, dill and lemon and fill.

name: Turkey Meatball and Spinach Stuffed Peppers
steps: Mix the turkey, spinach, garlic and parmesan.
Fill the halved peppers and top with marinara.
Bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

name: Cabbage and Ground Turkey Egg Roll Bowls
steps: Brown the turkey with garlic and ginger.
Add the slaw and soy sauce and cook 6 minutes; finish with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Spaghetti Squash with Turkey Marinara
steps: Roast and shred the squash.
Brown the turkey with the onion and simmer in the marinara.
Serve over the squash with parmesan and basil.

name: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Dry the chickpeas and toss with oil and seasoning.
Roast at 400°F for 25 minutes and toss with parmesan.

name: Egg Muffin Cups with Bell Pepper and Feta
steps: Divide the chopped pepper, spinach and feta among greased cups.
Pour in the eggs and bake at 375°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Tomato and Mozzarella Omelet with Basil
steps: Cook the beaten eggs in oil.
Fill with tomato, mozzarella and basil and fold.

name: Sausage, Egg and Cheese Roll-Ups on Tortillas
steps: Scramble the eggs with the crumbled sausage.
Fill the tortillas with the egg mix and cheddar and roll; serve with salsa.

name: Hearty Minestrone with Italian Sausage
steps: Brown the sausage with the vegetables.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth and seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender.

name: Lemon Chicken Orzo-Style Soup with Spinach
steps: Simmer the chicken and carrot in the broth 15 minutes; shred.
Add the pasta and cook until tender, then the spinach, lemon and dill.

name: Southwest Egg Roll Skillet with Ground Chicken
steps: Brown the chicken with the spices.
Add the slaw, beans and corn and cook 7 minutes.
Top with cheddar and lime.

name: Almond Butter Banana Oat Muffins
steps: Mash the banana and mix with the almond butter, eggs and milk.
Fold in the oats, baking powder and cinnamon.
Bake in a lined tin at 350°F for 20 minutes.

name: Bell Pepper and Ground Turkey Taco Boats
steps: Brown the turkey with the seasoning.
Fill the pepper halves, top with cheddar and bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.
Serve with salsa and avocado.

name: Chilled Cucumber Yogurt Soup with Dill
steps: Blend the cucumber, yogurt, garlic, dill, lemon and oil until smooth.
Chill and serve topped with walnuts.
